description: The crime cannot have happened the way it appears — find the trick mechanism
puzzle_mechanic: Locked room / impossible situation. The crime appears physically impossible (locked from inside, no entry/exit, victim alone). The trick is a specific physical mechanism. The 'how' is the core puzzle; the 'who' is narrowed once the mechanism is understood.

difficulty_scaling.easy: Single trick (door locked from outside made to look locked from inside), straightforward spatial reasoning
difficulty_scaling.medium: Compound trick (timed mechanism + hidden passage or dual-use tool), requires assembling spatial + temporal clues
difficulty_scaling.hard: The trick exploits a common assumption the reader makes (the 'locked' room was never actually locked, or the 'impossible' timing is based on a wrong premise)

generation_prompt:
You are generating an IMPOSSIBLE CRIME mystery scenario.

Core mechanic: TRICK MECHANISM. The crime scene presents a seemingly impossible situation (locked room, no entry/exit, impossible timing). The solver must figure out the physical trick that made it possible.

Evidence design rules:
- Start with a compelling impossibility statement in the case brief (room was locked from inside, all exits sealed, etc.)
- Include detailed spatial information: floor plans, measurements, building structure
- The trick must be PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE — it should use real-world mechanics (not supernatural)
- Critical evidence files should each reveal one piece of the trick mechanism
- Include a timeline with minute-level precision — the trick relies on specific timing
- Red herrings should suggest supernatural or impossible explanations, or point to a wrong mechanism
- The culprit is identified as the only person who had the tools, knowledge, and opportunity to execute the trick
- Include evidence about the building/room's physical features that the trick exploits (ventilation, mail slot, adjacent rooms, shared walls, etc.)

The answer.method must describe the COMPLETE trick mechanism step by step.
visual_style: Gothic architecture, diagrams with arrows, cross-section blueprints, dark corridors, locked doors

example_outline.title: The Sealed Studio
example_outline.setting: Artist's studio, 4th floor, single entrance, all windows locked from inside
example_outline.incident: Artist found dead in studio locked from inside, no entry/exit after 8PM per elevator log
example_outline.motive_hint: Noise complaint escalated to violent confrontation
example_outline.method_hint: Entered through shared ventilation duct, relocked deadbolt using fishing line through mail slot
example_outline.trick_mechanism: Ventilation duct access (structural report shows shared HVAC) + deadbolt locked remotely via string through mail slot gap
